note: Both sets struggle with some hallucinated elevations (e.g., reading 2'-0" or 2'-3" for Grade Level and Finished Floor, which are actually 0'-0" and 2'-9 1/2"). However, Set A contains a severe hallucination ('1/8" STEEL SINGLE HOUGHY') and misbinds the Finished Floor elevation to the solar thermal tubes. Set B extracts more accurate metadata (revisions, sheet number, tube configuration) and has fewer egregious errors.
